final_protocol:
1. Keep labeled microcentrifuge tubes containing samples on ice beside an Invitrogen E-Gel EX Agarose 1% gel cassette.

2. Pipette-mix or transfer each sample aliquot in its microcentrifuge tube using a single-channel micropipette, keeping the tubes on ice between handling.

3. Remove the comb from the E-Gel EX Agarose 1% cassette and position the gel with the wells accessible.

4. Load the prepared sample aliquot into a well of the E-Gel EX Agarose 1% cassette using a single-channel micropipette.

5. Insert the loaded E-Gel EX cassette into the Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap electrophoresis/imaging unit and close the amber lid.

6. On the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen, select the E-Gel EX 1–2% gel program and set the run time to 10 min.

7. Start the E-Gel Power Snap run and electrophorese the gel for 10 min.
